title: HubSpot Security
text: HubSpot Trust Center provides SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3. SAML-based SSO with Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin on Enterprise. Data centers in US, EU, Canada, Australia. By default, HubSpot does not use your customer data to train foundation models. AI Trust FAQs cover model training. SOC 2 Type II available in Trust Center. SAML SSO Enterprise. Data centers US EU Canada Australia.
